implementation_name: Caltech ionic external policy benchmark exact algorithms
status: frozen after target quality and identity audit but before any target outcome summary, source-model fit, policy trajectory, or policy endpoint was calculated

data_algorithms.doi_normalization: lowercase; remove doi URL or doi prefix; retain DOI tokens matching 10.<4-9 digits>/<suffix>; strip terminal punctuation
data_algorithms.icsd_normalization: lowercase nonempty comma/semicolon/pipe/slash-delimited tokens; convert integer-valued decimal strings to integer strings
data_algorithms.connected_components: union target rows sharing canonical composition, any normalized DOI, or any normalized ICSD token
data_algorithms.entity: one canonical composition with median log10 conductivity and its connected-component group
data_algorithms.split: sort connected groups by SHA256('20260716|<group id>'); select the single prefix whose cumulative entity count is closest to 70 percent as development and use the remainder as candidate
data_algorithms.hard_ood: standardize the 126 composition features using the full development partition; take ceil(0.40*candidate_n) candidates with largest Euclidean nearest-development distance
data_algorithms.initial_labels: sort development groups by SHA256('<campaign seed>|<group id>'); greedily add intact groups without exceeding 30; if fewer than 24 entities result, add the remaining group giving the smallest absolute deviation from 30
data_algorithms.acquisition_unit: one canonical composition; connected-component groups remain the cross-validation and split unit but do not make a multi-composition acquisition free

source_algorithms.filtering: remove a source row if its canonical composition or any normalized DOI occurs anywhere in the eligible target
source_algorithms.aggregation: median transformed outcome per canonical source composition after filtering
source_algorithms.source_group: connected component induced by canonical composition and normalized DOI before aggregation; missing DOI leaves composition as its own group
source_algorithms.quality: three-fold shuffled GroupKFold out-of-fold R2, RMSE, and Spearman rank correlation, random state 20260716
source_algorithms.prediction: one fixed source-model prediction for every target entity; higher transformed source outcome always has higher static priority
source_algorithms.shuffled_source: for each campaign seed, permute the leakage-safe OBELiX prediction across all target entities once and hold the permutation fixed for the campaign

target_algorithms.folds: exactly five shuffled GroupKFold folds over currently labelled target connected components; fewer than five groups forces zero target and source weights
target_algorithms.relative_gain: (reference fold RMSE - augmented fold RMSE) / reference fold RMSE
target_algorithms.admission: median five-fold relative gain >= 0.02, at least three fold gains > 0, and mean fold gain > 0
target_algorithms.weight: clip(median five-fold relative gain / 0.10,0,1) if admitted, otherwise zero
target_algorithms.target_reference: training-fold mean predictor; augmented prediction is composition-only ExtraTrees
target_algorithms.source_reference: composition-only ExtraTrees; augmented prediction is ExtraTrees on composition features plus one fixed source prediction
target_algorithms.rank: average percentile rank within the current candidate pool, increasing with novelty or predicted outcome
target_algorithms.source_correction: percentile rank of augmented prediction minus percentile rank of composition-only prediction
target_algorithms.novelty: Euclidean nearest-labelled distance in composition features standardized once using the complete development partition
target_algorithms.score: novelty rank + target weight times composition-model rank + the sum over at most two admitted sources of source weight times source correction
target_algorithms.source_selection: for multisource policies, select the two admitted sources with the largest median relative gain; deterministic ties use source id
target_algorithms.fallback: if target and source weights are all zero, the score is exactly novelty rank
target_algorithms.tie_break: largest score, then largest raw novelty, then lexicographically smallest canonical composition key

endpoint_algorithms.true_top_set: the ceil(0.05*candidate_n) entities with largest target outcome, with canonical composition key breaking an exact outcome tie
endpoint_algorithms.auc20: sum of cumulative true-top hit count after acquisitions 1 through 20
endpoint_algorithms.first_hit: first acquisition containing a true-top entity; budget+1 if none
endpoint_algorithms.recall: number of distinct acquired true-top entities divided by true-top-set size
endpoint_algorithms.regret: maximum candidate outcome minus best acquired outcome
endpoint_algorithms.uncertainty: paired campaign-seed bootstrap and paired sign flips; conditional on this database

exploratory_policy.reason: test a stronger exploration-preserving strategy without altering the seven primary contrasts
exploratory_policy.algorithm: run the same gates over every real and shuffled source; if any target or source component is admitted, restrict eligibility to candidates at or above the 65th percentile of current novelty and maximize the target-plus-source score inside that band; otherwise select pure novelty
exploratory_policy.interpretation: method-development only; excluded from confirmatory multiplicity and cannot establish an external edge even if favorable
